question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias for this release line, and is the PR's inbound-shaped helper scope sufficient?
rationale: This changes a public plugin runtime contract that was deliberately removed, and automation should not choose the deprecation window or legacy helper-name scope for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Scoped Alias
options.body: Resolve the conflict and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias while documenting that only the inbound-shaped helper set is restored.

options.title: Expand Legacy Scope First
options.body: Require the PR to restore the full pre-removal `turn` helper names before merge if maintainers want strict compatibility with the old object shape.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers decide old channel plugins must update to `channel.inbound.*` instead of re-expanding the runtime surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Alias
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict and land the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias while documenting that only the inbound-shaped helper set is restored.

likelyOwner.reason: The same history trail shows this owner introduced the alias removal and is the best available routing candidate for deciding whether to restore that contract.
